Read this list. If more than two hit — keep reading.

→ You know your DAW but consistently struggle to finish tracks
→ Your productions sound okay but don't have a clear, signature identity
→ You wait for inspiration instead of having a system that creates it
→ You've watched hundreds of tutorials but something is still missing
→ You want to produce consistently and make music that's authentically yours
→ You're serious about developing as an artist, not just as a technician
